entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Improve remaining JsonReaderInvalidTokenType exceptions during JSON materialization #39486
  • [JsonPropertyName] is ignored for complex properties and complex collections mapped to JSON #39484

Closed

  • Different Include/Where order leads to different SQL when using owned entity #30458
    12.0-preview1
  • JSON complex collection with a property mapped to "key" breaks element ordering: OPENJSON index column resolved to the property #39438
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Simplify adding and dropping CHECK constraints for SQLite migrations #39488
    community-contribution
  • Translate the TimeSpan Total* members on SQL Server #39487
    community-contribution
  • Improve exceptions for invalid elements in JSON entity collections #39485
    community-contribution
  • Add model-wide and member JSON reader/writer configuration #39483

Merged

  • Synchronize IncludePaths with ownerEntity on navigation expanding #39466
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Fix JSON collection element property named "key" colliding with the array index column #39475
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Add NOT NULL for persisted computed column if the column is not nullable #39417
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39463
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39465
  • Fix Vally experiment judge timeout forwarding #39474
    area-harness
  • Fix scalar ExecuteUpdate setter query precompilation #39307
  • Fix connection cancellation notifications to interceptors #39293
  • Fix query precompiler rejecting ThenInclude sources #39297
  • Preserve nonnullable coalesce results in precompiled queries #39314
  • Preserve independent Skip/Take parameters in precompiled queries #39478
    area-harness
  • Preserve implicit conversions during query precompilation #39313
    area-harness
  • Handle implicit numeric literal conversions in query precompilation #39312
    area-harness
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39391
